name: robosphere-site
description: RoboSphere v2 — multi-tenant smart home IoT platform (monorepo)

scripts.build: npm run build -w @robosphere/api && npm run build -w @robosphere/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @robosphere/api && npm run typecheck -w @robosphere/web && npm run typecheck -w @robosphere/shared
scripts.test: npm run test -w @robosphere/api && npm run test -w @robosphere/web
